text: G...Grr... R-Run...\nI can't... control myself any more...\nGrrraaaggghhhhh!!
You looked at Yelb's entire body but unlike\nDecel's, there was no black crystal on his body…
Ug... What am I doing...\n...Who is it?\n...I see. You saved me. Thanks.
I felt something evil invaded my mind when my\nbody began to wither...
Umm… I have no idea what it was…
I appreciate your help for releasing me from\nthe evil...
But judging from my body that is still weak,\nthings seem to be unpredictable as long as\nthat strange gate is still there.
The place beyond here almost turned into another\nworld because of the strange gate.\nStay alert and good luck.
